_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 35 windows showing ±2+ point moves and neither breaker present, the coil holds at the Denial/Disbelief boundary until a confirmed trigger arrives.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD while narrative implies a bullish setup without naming a direction; consensus defaults to the analyst's higher-trust coil read.
next_move.confirmed_if: stablecoin_growth breaks above 60 with btc_dom_fade holding 50+ (alt-led escape) OR funding drops below 35 with VIX spiking above 80 (final wash before recovery)
next_move.invalidated_if: LONG_AGGRESSIVE forced without either breaker present — a directional guess in a 0-of-35 coil is how the record went 0-for-18
